It’s insane how much energy we spend trying to shape life into what we think it should be. Always trying to fix, to improve or to to get somewhere.
The most meaningful moments arrive when we stop pushing. When we allow ourselves to be exactly where we are.
When we let joy be simple. When we stop turning every challenge into a problem that needs solving.
